issues.title: Add offline mode support for cached content
issues.body:
## Description
Implement an offline mode that allows the MCP server to work without internet connectivity by using cached content.

## Requirements
- Detect when Apple's site is unreachable
- Fall back to cached content gracefully
- Provide clear feedback about offline status
- Allow full search and browsing of cached content

## Acceptance Criteria
- [ ] Server works without internet if content is cached
- [ ] Clear indication when using cached vs live content
- [ ] Graceful degradation of features

issues.title: Implement incremental search index updates
issues.body:
## Description
Add support for incremental updates to the search index without re-indexing everything.

## Requirements
- Track last indexed timestamp for each URL
- Only re-index changed content
- Update search index incrementally
- Provide webhook/cron support for automatic updates

## Technical Details
- Store content hashes to detect changes
- Implement delta indexing algorithm
- Add CLI command for scheduled updates

issues.title: Optimize memory usage for large-scale indexing
issues.body:
## Description
Reduce memory footprint when indexing the entire HIG documentation.

## Current Issues

## Solutions

- Batch index updates
- Memory-mapped file storage
- Garbage collection optimization

issues.body:
## Description

## Current Issue

## Solution

- Maximum retry attempts
- Different strategies for different error types
- Circuit breaker pattern for repeated failures
